request: Define and qualify the Richards-specific temporal-error semantics before F-MR binds them into the transaction acceptance seam.

source_problem.current_semantics: 0 for exact final-state equality, huge(real64) otherwise
source_problem.scientific_gap: physically evolving Richards states expose finite graded full-step versus two-half-step discrepancies, but the production comparator discards their magnitude

requirements_for_fsi: State the temporal discretization contract for the admitted Richards route and whether the estimator relies on a formal order.
Choose the model-owned temporal observable or observables. Do not inherit F-MR16's diagnostic relative normalizations as production semantics.

If pressure head alone is selected, define units and tolerance semantics explicitly and justify why constitutive theta, ponding, groundwater and optional process state are either controlled indirectly or handled separately.
If multiple state components are selected, provide a source/theory basis for scalarization or expose separate controls. Do not introduce arbitrary Hscale/Thetascale constants.
Demonstrate that the selected temporal signal is not dominated by nonlinear convergence tolerances or route switching on the qualification profiles.
Characterize a sufficient dt ladder to establish the intended convergence regime or explicitly define behavior outside it.
Retain deterministic, side-effect-free evaluation from two candidate states and model-owned immutable/numerical configuration only. No hidden global state.
Support generic [t0,t1] intervals without calendar assumptions.
Keep authoritative mass completeness/residual acceptance separate and absolute.
Define conditional handling of ponding, groundwater and optional process state. Unused optional state must not be fabricated merely to satisfy the metric.

Keep the semantics usable behind the common soil-water solver interface so Full Richards, coarse Richards and future reduced-order solvers can own their own numerical error contract without F-MR knowing solver internals.
minimum_qualification_evidence_requested: nodewise signed and absolute h differences across full-step/two-half-step candidates
nodewise signed and absolute theta differences and maximizing-node information
signed dz-weighted theta storage-state difference if theta/storage is proposed as a control
solver-tolerance sensitivity characterization with unchanged physics
extended dt characterization sufficient to assess asymptotic behavior
active-state evidence or explicit exclusion contract for ponding, groundwater and optional states
O0/O2 and repeat determinism for the metric evaluation
mass-complete accepted/rejected transaction evidence with rejected trials uncommitted
return_path: F-SI/model owner implements and qualifies Richards temporal semantics
F-MR composes the model-owned signal into the existing F-KT acceptance seam
independent F-VQ scientifically qualifies the composed path
an accepted nontrivial Richards runtime is demonstrated
F-PE may then resume reference-tail characterization and only later bounded-cost policy qualification
